Android implementation vendored from Anxcye/share_handler at eeaa04d22e7e70babb55b6825b9ca7016e89c89a (0.0.11), under the included MIT license.

Modu changes: stream content/file URIs into unique cache folders, sanitize display names, reject missing streams, deduplicate Intent URIs, retain warm deliveries until the listener is ready, and report read failures. Upstream build.gradle is unchanged for the existing Gradle compatibility overlay.
